name: Cell polarity of a mass-conserving reaction-diffusion system
question: Is the direction of a polarity inherited when a cell divides below its critical length?
assumptions: the kinetics of the appendix of the source (from Mori et al. 2008) with its example values k = 0.07, D_m = 1, D_c = 10, mean density n = 2.4 (supercritical near the inflection point of the nullcline)
growth of the length at the rate 0.002; the growth dilutes both forms and the cell takes up the cytosolic form at the mean density n
division at L = 14 into two halves, each with the densities it received
additive noise of intensity 1e-6 per unit length

provenance.source: F. Brauns, J. Halatek and E. Frey, Phys. Rev. X 10, 041036 (2020), appendix; arXiv 1812.08684
